final_answer:
The typical resource requirements for training deep learning models include:

1. Large amounts of labeled data for training and validation. (Source: A Self-Supervised Approach for Enhanced Feature Representations in Object Detection Tasks)
2. High computational power, as deep learning models use multiple layers of neurons and require significant processing power. (Source: Artificial intelligence)
3. Skilled personnel to develop and manage the training process. (Source: A Self-Supervised Approach for Enhanced Feature Representations in Object Detection Tasks)

Additional information: Deep learning models can identify higher-level features from raw input, such as edges in image processing. (Source: Artificial intelligence)
